newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber firm on 6500t of SMR20 sales.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber firm on 6500t of SMR20 sales.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were steady at midday, with trade sources reporting sales of at least 6,500 tonnes of SMR20 to European and Asian clients.
"Trade is unusually heavy today after being dead for weeks," said a government trade source.
A June shipment of 1,500 tonnes of SMR20 was reported sold to Britain at 262 Malaysian/Singapore cents ($1.05) per kg, the source said.
He added that another two shipments of 2,500 tonnes each of SMR20 was sold to Turkey and Beijing at 267 cents per kg.
At midday, June RSS 1 buyer was quoted by the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board at 277.50 cents a kg, unchanged from Tuesday's close. June SMR 20 buyer was up one cent to 263.50.
Traders quoted the SMR20 at 261, SMR CV at 331, SMR 5 at 272, SMR L at 307, SMR 10 at 262 and drum latex at 227.
